JByDesign Editor (jbdeditor)

Full-featured enterprise rich text editor attached to native form textfields. 100% Vanilla JS, zero dependencies, no Node.js.

ADA / WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA Compliant HTML Block Templates Paste Cleaner (Strips Styles & Classes) Semantic Headings Color Palette & Highlights Floating Inline Toolbar (Medium/Notion) Accessible Tables (<th scope="col|row">) Images & Captions Special Characters Find & Replace Fullscreen Maximize Auto-Save Drafts Clean Source Code View Focus Trap Modals Roving Tabindex Toolbar

Accessibility Shortcuts: Alt+F10 focus toolbar or floating inline toolbar · ←/→ navigate toolbar controls · Esc exit toolbar/modals · Tab/Shift+Tab trapped inside modal dialogs. Tip: Select text to test the floating bubble toolbar!

Easy Integration Guide

Integrate JBDEditor into any application in under 60 seconds with zero dependencies.

Automatic Auto-Init via HTML attributes: 
<!-- 1. Include Stylesheet & Script -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/editor.css">
<script src="src/jbdeditor.js"></script>
 
<!-- 2. Add data-jbd-editor attribute to any <textarea> -->
<form action="/save" method="POST">
  <textarea 
    data-jbd-editor 
    data-jbd-toolbar="basic" 
    data-jbd-inline-toolbar="true"
    data-jbd-height="360px" 
    data-jbd-placeholder="Write your article..."
    name="content">Initial content</textarea>
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
Standard JavaScript attach API: 
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/editor.css">
<script src="src/jbdeditor.js"></script>

<textarea id="my-editor" name="content"></textarea>

<script>
  const editor = JBDEditor.attach('#my-editor', {
    toolbar: 'basic',        // 'full' | 'basic' | 'minimal' | 'article' | false
    inlineToolbar: true,     // Contextual selection bubble toolbar
    height: '380px',
    placeholder: 'Write your story...',
    autoSaveKey: 'post_draft',
    onChange: (html, text) => {
      console.log('Updated HTML:', html);
    }
  });
</script>
Medium / Notion-Style Floating Selection Bubble Toolbar: 
<!-- Zero-JS Declarative: -->
<textarea data-jbd-editor data-jbd-inline-toolbar="true">Highlight text to see the floating toolbar!</textarea>

<!-- Or via JavaScript API: -->
<script>
  // Option A: Minimal top toolbar + floating selection bubble toolbar:
  const editor = JBDEditor.attach('#my-editor', {
    toolbar: 'minimal',
    inlineToolbar: true
  });

  // Option B: Distraction-free Notion / Medium style (no top toolbar at all):
  const notionEditor = JBDEditor.attach('#distraction-free-canvas', {
    toolbar: false,
    inlineToolbar: true
  });

  // Option C: Custom inline button list:
  const customEditor = JBDEditor.attach('#custom-editor', {
    inlineToolbar: ['bold', 'italic', 'underline', 'link', 'highlight', 'clear']
  });
</script>
SPAs, HTMX, Alpine, Vue, React, & Turbo: 
// Scan and initialize any textareas added to the page:
JBDEditor.initAll();

// Access the instance attached to an element anytime:
const editor = JBDEditor.get('#my-editor');
console.log(editor.getHTML());

// Cleanly unmount / destroy on page transition:
JBDEditor.detach('#my-editor');

// Or tear down all active editors:
JBDEditor.destroyAll();
Native Form Submission & Event Listening: 
// 1. Native form submissions and FormData work automatically:
document.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
  const formData = new FormData(e.target);
  console.log(formData.get('content')); // Always guaranteed up-to-date!
});

// 2. Pub/Sub Lifecycle Events:
editor.on('change', (html, text) => {
  console.log('Content changed:', text.length, 'chars');
});

editor.on('ready', (ed) => console.log('Ready to write!'));
editor.on('focus', () => console.log('User focused editor'));
editor.on('blur', () => console.log('User left editor'));
